predictions.rationale: Bootstraps IdentityServer and ASP.NET Core Identity, configuring authentication, tokens, and external clients.
Implements login, logout, registration, and account management endpoints that issue and revoke tokens.
Defines identity resources, API scopes, clients, and token settings used for authentication flows.
Contains the core logic that validates user credentials and issues authentication results.
Entity Framework context where user accounts and identity tables are stored and queried.
Represents the user entity with fields relevant to authentication and account management.
Handles user consent for scopes and resources, an essential part of issuing access tokens.
Attaches bearer tokens to outgoing HTTP requests, protecting downstream services with issued tokens.
Extracts user identity and token information inside the Basket microservice, enforcing authorization.
Provides identity and token-related utilities within the Ordering service to authenticate requests.
